A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the evolution of the size and shape of the BCG is mainly due to feedback processes, and the evolution of their mass is mainly due to merging events.
the feedback processes have played a major role in the formation and evolution of BCGs.
the BCGs are the result of a complex interplay of different processes that are still not fully understood.

we need a more detailed understanding of the feedback processes acting in the BCGs to be able to fully understand the evolution of these galaxies in the last 10 Gyr.

the BCGs are not simply scaled versions of the present-day galaxies.
